```python
result = 0
for right in range(len(nums)):
    lookup = {nums[right]}
    curr = 0
    for left in reversed(range(right)):
        if nums[left] not in lookup:
            lookup.add(nums[left])
            curr += 1 - (nums[left] - 1 in lookup) - (nums[left] + 1 in lookup)
        result += curr
return result
```
